## validateWithdrawAmount() function

Validates that the withdraw assets do not exceed the user's supplied assets in the market.

**Signature:**

```typescript
validateWithdrawAmount: (params: {
    positionData: AccrualPosition;
    withdrawAssets: bigint;
    marketId: MarketId;
}) => void
```

`WithdrawExceedsSupplyError` when `withdrawAssets > positionData.supplyAssets`<!-- -->.

## Remarks

Parameter details:
